physics-killer-07.title: Seerota sochii Newton fi tiyoorii wal-qabatiinsa addaa
physics-killer-07.topic: Seerota sochii Newton fi tiyoorii wal-qabatiinsa addaa
physics-killer-07.goal: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.
physics-killer-07.material: Lafa irraa yeroo ilaalamu urjii tokkoo hanga isaa fageenyi $6$ waggaa-ifaa dha. Doonni samii lafa irraa gara urjii kanaatti saffisa dhaabbataa $0.6c$ tiin deemee urjii sana gaha. Ilaaltuu lafaa irraa yeroo balali'insaa safare fi sa'aatii doonii keessaa safarame yeroo balali'insaa hordoffiidhaan sirriitti kan wal-qabsiise isa kami? (Saffisni ifaa $c$ waggaa-ifaa $1$ waggaatti dha.)
physics-killer-07.thinking.0: Seerota sochii Newton fi tiyoorii wal-qabatiinsa addaa
physics-killer-07.s.s1.prompt: Lafa irraa yeroo ilaalamu urjii tokkoo hanga isaa fageenyi $6$ waggaa-ifaa dha. Doonni samii lafa irraa gara urjii kanaatti saffisa dhaabbataa $0.6c$ tiin deemee urjii sana gaha. Ilaaltuu lafaa irraa yeroo balali'insaa safare fi sa'aatii doonii keessaa safarame yeroo balali'insaa hordoffiidhaan sirriitti kan wal-qabsiise isa kami? (Saffisni ifaa $c$ waggaa-ifaa $1$ waggaatti dha.)
physics-killer-07.s.s1.explain: Ilaaltuu lafaa: $\Delta t=\dfrac{6\text{ waggaa-ifaa}}{0.6c}=10$ waggaa. $\gamma=1/\sqrt{1-0.6^2}=1/0.8=1.25$. Sa'aatiin doonii bakka tokkotti ba'uu fi gahuu lamaan illee waan safaruuf yeroo dhugaa dha; $\Delta t_0=\Delta t/\gamma=10/1.25=8$ waggaa. Yoo baay'isan $12.5$ waggaa (deebii dogoggoraa ③), $\gamma^2$ tiin yoo qoodan $6.4$ waggaa (deebii dogoggoraa ①), gatii lamaan yoo jijjiiran deebii dogoggoraa ④ ta'a. (Ilaalcha doonii irraa fageenyi $6/1.25=4.8$ waggaa-ifaa tti gabaabbata, $4.8/0.6=8$ waggaa wajjin wal-simata.)
